name: Music player
summary: A compact player card: album art, title and artist, a waveform you can seek, elapsed and total time, previous, play and next, and volume.
use: in a media or podcast app
a11y: Seek and volume are native range inputs with names, and seek reads its time as "1:47 of 3:53"; play changes its name to Pause while playing, and the album art is decorative.
